specs.v: Yellowish beige with a greenish patina

description.html: This water dish is styled as sandstone: the sides are layered as if shaped by wind and water, and the surface is yellowish beige with a greenish patina, like a stone covered with lichen. The shape is irregular, with one higher and one lower part of the rim.

The warm yellowish tones blend well into desert and semi-desert setups with leopard geckos, bearded dragons and similar species, especially with a lighter substrate and rocks. The textured edges make it easier for your animal to get in and out, since its claws have something to grip.

A water dish is still a must in a dry terrarium, but place it on the cooler side, away from the heat lamp, so the water does not evaporate quickly and humidity stays low. Change the water every day and watch that sand does not build up in it; if it does, raise the dish on a flat stone or set it directly on the terrarium floor. Scrub the layered edges with a brush once a week.
